description: Two dancers trade places, one rolling across in front of the other.

walkthrough.line: Take near hands with {who}: {roller} rolls across in front and the other slides behind.
walkthrough.teach: Take near hands with {who}. Then {roller} rolls across in front of the other, turning once round on the way, while the other slides sideways into the place they came from. You have traded places and you both still face the way you were. Four beats, hands joined through the roll.

call.4: ROLL AWAY WITH A HALF SASHAY
